messages:
Sam: Quick thread on intake token economy - we keep burning budget on benches that provide low signal. idea: make benches consume "intake tokens" that reflect expected runtime cost and signal value.
Asha: Love the framing. Tokens let us reason about budget and priority. Need two token classes: cost_tokens (GPU/time) and value_tokens (expected regression-detection probability).
Ravi: Practical concern: how do we estimate value_tokens reliably? we could bootstrap from historical detection rates per prompt-bucket and model-family. not perfect but workable.
Mei: Proposal: intake computes `estimated_cost` and `expected_value` per bench request. it charges cost_tokens immediately and puts value_tokens on hold until results return. escalation lanes can spend extra value_tokens.
Sam: Interface sketch: POST /intake/request { model, bench_type, seq_len_hint } -> { request_id, cost_tokens, value_tokens_reserved, lane }. workers verify `request_id` and that `tokens_charged` were deducted.
Asha: For Dedicated customers we allow pre-purchased token packs and a peek policy so owners can see token burn forecasts. for hosted free-tier, token caps per org prevent runaway benches.
Ravi: Behavior under backpressure: if runtime_p95 > target, intake reduces opportunistic scheduling by factoring in token_price = cost_tokens * runtime_multiplier. higher multiplier -> fewer benches.
Mei: Also need a reclamation path: if a bench is cancelled or preempted, refund partial cost_tokens based on work done. value_tokens should be refunded only if the bench didn't produce a valid signal.
Sam: Security/contract: tokens must be accounted in logs with `request_id` and `customer_id`. Private deploys run local token ledger and can opt out, but sign-in/consistency checks required.
Asha: Observability: surface `tokens_burned_by_model`, `avg_value_per_token`, `refund_rate`. these feed Optimize to tune default token pricing by workload.
Ravi: Next steps: Mei will add token fields to intake proto; I'll prototype historical value estimation job; Sam will add billing hooks for Dedicated.
token-bot: reserved 120 cost_tokens for request:1955554321 (eta:69s) :coin:
Mei: Thanks team. We'll iterate on the estimation model and keep defaults conservative to avoid starving safety benches.
